opening.argument: The speaker identifies this as a podcast series about the Solana Developer Platform, and the discussion describes payments as part of that platform. Those are the observable features of an informational interview about Modern Treasury, stablecoin payment infrastructure, and the platform: the speakers discuss professional backgrounds, payment-system capabilities, and infrastructure questions that remain unresolved. Nothing in the cited material asks viewers to invest, transfer funds, or provide private information. The description also characterizes the content as general rather than individualized. Although the material disclaims an offer or solicitation involving securities, the narrower point is enough here: the discussion explains payment technology without directing the viewer to take a financial action.

citations.quote: We have this mini-Podcast series around the Solana developer platform.
Payments will be a part of the Solana developer platform.
This content is intended to be general in nature and is not specific to you
